name: neuroshima-2026-overrides
description: Dev tooling (compendium/icon/token builders) for the Neuroshima 5e FoundryVTT module. Not the module's own version — that's module.json. No build step for the module itself: scripts/main.mjs is loaded by Foundry as-is (see DEV_GUIDE.md §4).

scripts.build:classes: python dev/classes/gen_features.py && npm run build:icons && npm run build:packs && npm run validate:packs
scripts.build:bestiary: npm run extract:bestiary && npm run gen:bestiary && node dev/packs/build-packs.mjs --only=bestiariusz
